claims.statement: For one frozen pure candidate with a strictly signed common scale interval M and arm-specific input-effect intervals D1,D2, the exact two-arm judgment-effect region is P={m(d1,d2):m in M, di in Di}; its coordinate interval products form an exact marginal hull but only a conservative Cartesian outer rectangle.
claims.domain: Two randomized intervention arms, one fixed response coding and one common candidate scale across arms.
all_premises: pure linear candidate on the declared family
claims.proof: Continuous image of the compact product domain; coordinate extrema occur at interval-product corners; common m couples coordinates.
claims.counterexamples_limits: Arm-specific gains can fill more of the outer rectangle; mixed or nonlinear bridges are outside scope.

claims.statement: For strictly positive scale intervals Ma,Mb, the two common-scale prediction regions intersect exactly when some lambda in Mb/Ma makes Dai intersect lambda Dbi for both arms, equivalently Lai<=lambda Ubi and lambda Lbi<=Uai for each arm.
claims.domain: A4K-C1 regions with positive scale intervals.
all_premises: both scales bounded away from zero
claims.proof: Divide equal predicted vectors by their positive scales for necessity; choose coordinate intersections and scales with the feasible ratio for sufficiency.
claims.counterexamples_limits: A zero-containing or disconnected-sign orientation requires a different branched analysis.

claims.statement: A frozen outcome uncertainty box O intersects a candidate region exactly when one m in M satisfies L_Oi<=m U_Di and m L_Di<=U_Oi for both arms.
claims.domain: Same common-scale candidate with rectangular outcome uncertainty.
all_premises: outcome box frozen under a declared error rule
claims.proof: Interval intersection for each scaled coordinate becomes four linear inequalities in the same scalar m.
claims.counterexamples_limits: Compatibility is not confirmation; wrong coverage or response mapping invalidates the result.

claims.statement: If the readout-orientation interval contains zero and candidate gains are positive, both prediction regions contain the zero vector, so global separation fails and strict sign transfer is not warranted.
all_premises: zero is admitted by the pre-outcome orientation set
claims.proof: Choose readout scale zero under either candidate.
claims.counterexamples_limits: A particular nonzero observed box may still reject one branch, but it does not retroactively orient the scale.

claims.statement: If the input, orientation or gain intervals are statistical, prediction-region coverage is conditional on their declared simultaneous pre-outcome coverage event; marginal coverage levels and post-outcome interval choice do not supply that joint guarantee.
all_premises: joint inclusion is needed for the candidate vector
claims.proof: Logical propagation holds on the intersection of all calibration events; no stronger probability follows without a joint-error argument.
claims.counterexamples_limits: Deterministic physical bounds do not need a confidence interpretation but still need independent warrant.

claims.statement: The interval analysis does not calibrate H_cont, install actual RetBind use, establish complete bearer organization or alter C1/U1; without independent bounds the line stops at organizational and judgment consequences.
claims.counterexamples_limits: A future actual jointly calibrated installation could enable a new scoped application; none exists here.
